mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates improving consumer confidence and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines > 100,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (as indicated by GDPC1 growth above 3.0% annualized), the economy is nearing peak activity, which increases the risk of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
